versions.changelog:
- Initial release of super-agent-browser skill, based on the agent-browser CLI.
- Provides headless browser automation optimized for AI agents, featuring real-time accessibility tree snapshots and deterministic, ref-based element selection.
- Supports navigation, form filling, data extraction, multi-session isolation, state persistence, and network control via CLI commands.
- Includes best practices, example workflows (search & extract, multi-session testing), and installation instructions.
- Ideal for web scraping, autonomous testing, and complex automation workflows where performance and reliability are critical.
